newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles sees improvement at World4Kids.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles sees improvement at World4Kids.

text.p: Coles Myer Ltd said on Thursday that its World 4 Kids toy division was performing ahead of plan, and a reduction in losses should continue.
"W4K is performing better than plan and the reduction in losses should continue," chief executive Dennis Eck said in a statement accompanying the retailer's half year results.
Sales in the 26 weeks to January 26, 1997 were down 9.4 percent to A$59.9 million from A$66.1 million previously.
The division recorded a loss of A$12.5 million in earnings before interest and tax (EBIT), down from an EBIT loss of A$20.1 million in the previous corresonding period.
Coles Myer said the integration of management and infrastructure with Kmart has been completed, and the World 4 Kids brand now exists as part of KMart's toy and leisure business.
"Real estate negotiations have been completed to close or rebadge eight stores, using other company brands where feasible," it said.
Coles Myer reported a net profit of A$273.6 million for the six months to January 26 from A$194.5 million a year earlier.
